Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Ledbetter
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/16/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 221 as introduced would provide for the issuance of a temporary license plate to transporters or manufacturers of certain motor vehicles, pursuant to the provisions of this bill, which would increase receipts to the Public Road and Bridge Fund and the funds of the local license plate issuing officials by $1.50 and $0.75, respectively, for each temporary license plate issued by a vehicle transporter or manufacture.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Melson
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 56 as passed the Senate allows counties and municipalities that provide solid waste services to use funds in its solid waste reserve account over $1 million for any lawful purpose in the best interest of the locality.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
